params.body: Since portal#338 and portal-cli#6 the workbench at home reads Portal (fleet, onboard, changes) by signing each request with its own key, and the brief withholds the access codes from it, admitted or not. The core instructions say so and the item leaves the to-do list. Proposed from the workbench at home.
params.title: The workbench at home reads Portal with its own key
